pages.title: Star quality
paragraphs: Everything you grow, pick, collect, catch or make can come out Normal, Silver or Gold. Silver and gold items have a star and the word Silver or Gold on them in your barn.
About 1 in 8 things comes out silver and about 1 in 33 comes out gold. Each item rolls on its own, so a harvest of 3 can be 2 normal and 1 gold.
Silver sells for a quarter more at the barn and gold for half as much again. Tap a silver or gold tile in the barn to sell just those; the item card shows all three prices.
Villagers love a silver or gold gift: it counts for more friendship than a normal one.
Orders, the truck, the stall and the market always take your normal items first, so your stars are kept for gifts and selling.
Feed, worm bait and fertiliser are tools, not produce, so they never have a star.

pages.title: Star ingredients
paragraphs: Workshop goods can roll a star too. If you have enough silver (or gold) of every ingredient, the recipe shows Use star ingredients.
Pick Silver or Gold, then tap Make: the job takes those star ingredients and the goods come out silver or gold. The next job is normal again unless you pick it again.
If you take back a star job before it starts, your star ingredients come back with their stars.

pages.title: Fertiliser
paragraphs: Fertiliser is made at the Feed Mill from level 8: 2 wheat and 1 corn make 2 bags in 2 minutes.
When you plant, the seed tray shows a Fertiliser switch first. While it is On, every field you sow uses one bag. It turns itself off when the last bag is used.
A fertilised field has a better chance of silver and gold when you harvest it: about 1 in 5 silver and 1 in 12 gold. Tap a growing field to see if it was fertilised.
